messages:
maya: quick heads-up — saw steady KV cache memory creep in long-context perf runs, ~12% RSS increase over 30m with identical QPS
conor: repro steps? which model, kernel, and allocator config?
maya: opt-13b-q4a, kernel=v2.3, batching stable. suspect fragmentation + tiny-chunk churn (lots of small slabs).
aj: can you paste the top-level perf counters / a short flamegraph snippet?
maya: pasted metrics below and a quick prom query I used:
```promql
sum(kv_fragment_count) by (block_size)
max(kv_reuse_chain_len_bucket)
kv_fragmentation_ratio{pool=\"kv\"}
```
maya: also captured a perf run: `perf record -e cpu-clock -F 99 -- ./serve --workload longctx --kv-config small-blocks`
lee: looked at the counters — 32B and 96B buckets have high alloc+free rates and free-list churn. free-list contention is non-trivial on hot threads.
lee: hypothesis: tokenization patterns create many short-lived small allocations; too many micro-splits when reusing long-context kv entries.
conor: interesting. did you try bumping min block size or increasing block coalescing window?
maya: quick canary: min_block=64B reduced fragment_count(32B) by ~70%, overall RSS stabilized but tail token latency p95 increased slightly on bursts.
aj: tradeoff expected — bigger blocks mean more internal slack but fewer meta entries and less allocator pressure. we need a middle ground.
aj: suggestion: add a `reuse_chain_len` histogram per-block and prefer compacting fragments with reuse_chain_len==0 and contiguous adjacent free blocks. Also track "neighbor_free_runs" metric.
conor: practical note: our compactor currently stops when background work > 0.2 CPU quota. When we ran aggressive compaction, p99 token latency jumped ~8ms under sustained QPS. compaction must be rate-limited and be load-aware.
lee: propose two changes: (1) instrument per-bucket reuse_chain_len and contiguous_free_run counters, (2) implement a batch-coalescer with heuristic: only coalesce if contiguous_free_run >= 2 and estimated reclaimed_bytes >= 4x compaction_cost.
maya: ran a canary with compaction_thresh=0.6 and compaction_rate=0.05; memory stabilized across 60m but observed a +5ms p95 in spike scenarios.
perf-bot: scheduled nightly perf/job:id/kv-repro-1798765432 for full-heap sampling and automated flamegraphs (results tomorrow).
conor: also add eviction trace ids to correlate specific requests to KV evictions — helped us find a long-tail request pattern last month.
aj: small offline experiment idea: simulate batching patterns with synthetic long-context traces and run alloc sampling to measure coalescer benefit before shipping compactor.
lee: I'll open a tiny PR to add the telemetry fields (reuse_chain_len histogram, neighbor_free_runs, per-bucket churn_rate). want to test on dedicated-dev cluster first.
maya: ++, please also add a debug flag to the compactor to make it conservative (no compaction during active bursts).
deploy-bot: canary deployed to dedicated-dev cluster (kv-experiments/compactor-flag)
conor: +1 from me, keep logs light.
aj: I'll wire the flamegraphs and attach results to the perf ticket once nightly job completes.
maya: thanks — will follow up with flamegraphs and a short summary. :thumbsup:
